status_vocabulary.conflicting: at least two official sources in disagreement — manual arbitration required (exhaustive list in DOCUMENTED_CONFLICTS).

current_freshness_rule.definition: stale ⇔ obs_year < current year − 1 (freshness.py, display only — score and verdict unchanged)
current_freshness_rule.per_indicator_uniformity: a single rule for everything: annual macro, rates, ratings, CDS, market levels, qualitative

annual_macro.proposed: keep the uniform rule: ⚠ if observation year < current year − 1
annual_macro.rationale: national accounts, CPI, unemployment and debt are published as annual vintages; the current uniform threshold matches that granularity.

policy_rate.proposed: ⚠ if the decision is older than ~3 months; require the exact decision date (not « 2024 »).
policy_rate.rationale: the policy rate is the most volatile datum in the corpus; an annual vintage hides dated revisions.

rating.proposed: re-verify agency matrices every ~6 months (actions/outlooks); deliberate NR (LBN/SYR) preserved unless contradicted by evidence.
rating.rationale: interim agency actions (outlooks) are more frequent than the annual cycle.

cds.proposed: if quoted: keep a quote date; if unquoted: documented absence treated as a deliberate signal (never « stale »).
cds.rationale: near-daily series; the absence of a market remains the model's chosen signal.

market_levels.proposed: monthly reserves (⚠ once the published quarter has passed); 1-year performance recomputed at least quarterly.
market_levels.rationale: reserves are published monthly; rolling performances have no meaningful annual vintage.

qualitative.proposed: dated annual review (a `reviewed` field to introduce), never automatically « stale ».
qualitative.rationale: editorial assessments are not observations; their age is not a market vintage.

known_issues.title: Real-rate temporal mixing (Lebanon) — known, not corrected
known_issues.finding: policy_rate 20.0 % (vintage 2024, source « Banque du Liban ») is combined with inflation 14.6 % (2025, WDI, applied in 6.1) → real_rate = 5.4, inside the [−8, 6] band → rate_s = 40. This vintage mixing is a property of the data, not a model rule; it is recorded here as a known issue without changing the calculation.
known_issues.impact: stabilite (inflation w 0.45, policy w 0.15, currency w 0.40) → risk (w 0.40) → verdicts.
known_issues.evidence_required: current BDL policy rate (BDL site/bulletin) with the exact decision date.
known_issues.action: batch B2 (policy-rate refresh) — not a formula change.

known_issues.title: NR rating and unquoted CDS (Lebanon, Syria)
known_issues.finding: rating = NR and cds = None for both countries → rating_score = 20, cds_score = none_score = 5, CRP falls back to the rating spread (15.5 × 1.5), and the verdict is capped at « Attendre » regardless of the score (blocking_ratings). This is a deliberate model signal, but it rests on 2024 vintages.
known_issues.evidence_required: dated agency matrices; sourced confirmation that no quoted CDS market exists.

known_issues.title: Unemployment values in conflict (Lebanon 30, Syria 50)
known_issues.finding: No citable national survey; diverging ILO modelled series (LBN 11.0 in 2023, WDI 2024/25 null; SYR 13.6 in 2025); crisis levels (30/50) without a traceable citation. Documented conflicts — no default arbitration.
known_issues.impact: dynamisme (w 0.20) + the « Attendre » rescue path (dynamisme ≥ 55 threshold).

known_issues.title: Lebanon GDP 2024: three institutional vintages
known_issues.finding: Production −6.5 (IMF) vs WDI+LEM −7.1 vs WEO Oct 2026 −5.2. The file stays at −6.5; conflict documented.
known_issues.impact: dynamisme (w 0.55) — the largest dynamisme influence in the corpus.

known_issues.title: Per-observation provenance nearly absent
known_issues.finding: Out of 100 data pairs, ONLY lebanon-inflation carries source_url/obs_status/retrieved (the pattern set in 6.1). meta.sources is a dataset-level registry, not per observation. Absent fields (verification impossible) are distinguished from missing values.
known_issues.impact: capacity to re-verify and refresh repeatedly; the displayed freshness flag is currently the only signal.
known_issues.evidence_required: backfill URL + obs_status + retrieved at each future application batch (the 6.1 pattern).

known_issues.title: Real-rate band specification vs code mismatch (documentation only)
known_issues.finding: docs/MODEL_PARAMS.md §4.2 describes the bands as « inclusive-low / exclusive-high » while the code compares low ≤ real ≤ high (inclusive on both ends). The difference only appears at exact band edges (e.g. real = 4.0 → code 72, strict doc reading 40). No country sits on an edge today; this is a documentation/test alignment finding, with no formula change in this increment.
known_issues.impact: no current score effect; a future vintage could land on an edge.
known_issues.evidence_required: decide the documentary convention (align the doc to the code, or the reverse via a dedicated increment).
